design.alpha_scope: alpha affects ONLY the final route selection; it does not affect GA search evolution, stagnation detection, convergence generation or the evaluated Pareto-front population.
design.search_policy: one explicit frozen default policy, used for the generation-zero progress reference, the in-loop stagnation comparison and the convergence generation
design.final_selection_policy: the requested C2 alpha with the C2 priority and guardrails

superseded_experiment.reason: Its search was unintentionally alpha-dependent because the generation-zero selection used the requested alpha while the in-loop stagnation selection fell back to the frozen default.

original_confirmatory_result.statement: The frozen 90-pair thermal ablation remains the confirmatory fixed-policy result and is not replaced by this sensitivity analysis.
